usageNotes: This is a directory-index endpoint that returns the list of child API resources under /cluster/notifications (e.g., endpoints, matchers, targets). Call it to discover which notification sub-resources are available before navigating to a specific child endpoint. No parameters are required and no special privileges are needed — any authenticated user or API token can call it.

examples.summary: List all notification sub-resource endpoints on the cluster

tips: The returned objects contain a 'name' property that maps to the child endpoint path segment (e.g., 'endpoints', 'matchers', 'targets').
Use this as an entry point to traverse the notifications API tree — follow child links to manage notification targets or matchers.
